reason: NONE. What I noticed first was the price on a box of foil sachets with no reviews, then the QR lab report, which is nice but it is the brand's own claim and there is no NSF or USP seal. I already reorder my Thorne or Pure Encapsulations on Subscribe & Save, and I am not swapping a bottle I trust for an unknown brand at $1 a day.
objection: Unknown brand, zero reviews, no NSF or USP seal, and I pay more per serving than my bottle for packaging I do not need. Two capsules per sachet is also a lot of swallowing, since big capsules are hard for me.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP certification on the box, a few hundred real reviews, and a price per serving close to what I pay now, or a Subscribe & Save discount.
